    LargeIndecomposable.AR.isIrr_summand

    Summands of minimal right almost split maps are irreducible #

    For a right minimal right almost split g : E → Z into a nonzero indecomposable and a decomposition of E, each component E_i → Z is irreducible (isIrr_summand).
